title: 7.3 My Clothes
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Name clothes and their colors, and say whose they are: Mi camisa es roja.
grammar_function: Este/Esta es…; Estos son…; mi/su + clothing + es/son + color (agreeing).
speaking_outcome: Name clothes and their colors, and say whose they are: Mi camisa es roja.
